svg.title: Illustrated planet of Bengaluru
svg.desc: Bengaluru: 694620 building footprints, 165025 roads, 10410 parks and 3854 water bodies from OpenStreetMap mapped onto a small globe. Landmarks: Vidhana Soudha, Vikasa Soudha, Karnataka High Court, Cubbon Park, M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, State Central Library, Government Museum, Visvesvaraya Museum, Freedom Park.
